sample_1.prompt: A young woman leaning back comfortably on a sofa after a lavish dinner, one hand resting on her stomach, expression slightly uncomfortable but content. The dining table behind her is covered with the remnants of a rich meal — half-empty wine glasses, candles, and empty dishes. Warm candlelight fills the room. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm amber tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: A university student sitting at a library desk surrounded by dense academic textbooks and highlighted notes, rubbing her temples as she slowly processes complex information. Soft reading lamp light glows over the pages. The background shows tall bookshelves fading into bokeh. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, cool-neutral tones, cinematic intimate composition.

sample_3.prompt: A thoughtful middle-aged businessman sitting alone by a floor-to-ceiling office window at dusk, staring out at the city skyline with a folded newspaper in his hand, processing shocking news in silence. The room behind him is dimly lit. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, blue and gold city tones, cinematic wide composition.
